    <dc:title>The Poet Empress</dc:title>
    <dc:creator opf:file-as="Tao, Shen" opf:role="aut">Shen Tao</dc:creator>
    <dc:contributor opf:role="bkp">calibre (8.16.2) [https://calibre-ebook.com]</dc:contributor>
    <dc:description><p><b>Debut author Shen Tao introduces readers to the lush, deadly world of <i>The Poet Empress, </i>a sweeping, epic and intimate fantasy perfect for fans of <i>The Serpent & the Wings of Night, The Song of Achilles </i>and<i> She Who Became the Sun</i>.</b><br>In the waning years of the Azalea Dynasty, the emperor is dying, the land consumed by famine, and poetry magic lost to all except the powerful.<br>Wei Yin is desperate. After the fifth death of a sibling, with her family and village on the brink of starvation, she will do anything to save those she loves.<br>Even offer herself as concubine to the cruel heir of the beautiful and brutal Azalea House.<br>But in a twist of fate, the palace stands on the knife-edge of civil war with Wei trapped in its center...at the side of a violent prince.<br>To survive, Wei must harden her heart, rely on her wit, and become dangerous herself. Even if it means becoming a poet in a world where women are forbidden to read&#8212;and composing...</dc:description>
